mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.description, p.price, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.category_name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.description AS category_description FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.id = pc.product_id LEFT JOIN category c ON pc.category_id = c.id ORDER BY p.id, c.sort_order

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.description, p.price AS product_price, g.id AS goods_id, g.goods_name, g.sku, g.specification, g.stock, g.price AS goods_price FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_goods pg ON p.id = pg.product_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON pg.goods_id = g.id ORDER BY p.id, g.id

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.description, p.price, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at, c.category_name, c.parent_id, c.sort_order, c.description AS category_description FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_category pc ON p.id = pc.product_id LEFT JOIN category c ON pc.category_id = c.id WHERE p.id = #{productId} ORDER BY c.sort_order

SELECT p.id, p.product_name, p.product_code, p.description, p.price AS product_price, g.id AS goods_id, g.goods_name, g.sku, g.specification, g.stock, g.price AS goods_price FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_goods pg ON p.id = pg.product_id LEFT JOIN goods g ON pg.goods_id = g.id WHERE p.id = #{productId} ORDER BY g.id
